title: Catalog discovery
purpose: Find a product in a public catalog, judge whether it suits from exact evidence, and inspect or compare products without losing the search.
useWhen: A remote catalog of products is searched with counted facets, sorted, paged and opened into product detail or a comparison.
avoidWhen: A small local collection the person may fully see: filter it in place with FilterBar and DataTable relevance.
Records a team works through (tickets, invoices): use async collection inside the records frame.
alternatives: Async collection for service-backed records that aren't products.
Digital-goods acquisition for what happens after a product is chosen.
requiredInputs: search adapter for the whole applied query (q, facets, sort, page or cursor) returning the person's authorized result set
per-facet counts for the applied query, and whether each is exact, approximate or unknown
public product facts: exact version, release date, formats, size, license, price with currency, publisher
compatibility evidence per version: verified or incompatible with engine, digest, date tested and limits; otherwise not tested
the signed-in person's own state (owned version), kept apart from public facts
ranking basis for each sort label, and how sponsored placements are marked
transitions: draft edit → draft-differs; the URL is unchanged
Apply, search submit, sort or page → URL entry → refreshing → populated or no-results or refresh-failed
an older response arriving after a newer request → dropped
refresh-failed → Retry search repeats the current query
result link → product-detail (focus its heading) → Back restores offset and focuses the product's link
applicability: Remote product catalogs with search, counted facets, product detail and comparison.
exceptions: Only states the search service supports are required; do not fabricate counts, cursors or compatibility evidence.
A comparison limit is an application choice; four keeps columns readable at 320px with sideways scrolling.
